840:   SAMPLER — pad sample slot + piano sampler (theme-matched)
842:.pad-sample{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:125px minmax(0,1fr) minmax(150px,.42fr) auto;grid-template-areas:"slot wave meta act" "slot edit edit act";min-height:74px;margin-top:7px;border:1px solid #1d241b;background:#090b09}
843:.ps-slot{grid-area:slot;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:5px;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;border-right:1px solid #242b22}
846:.ps-slot small{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font:600 6px var(--r3-mono);color:#6a7465;letter-spacing:.08em}
851:.ps-wave canvas{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block}
852:.ps-empty{position:absolute;inset:4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:10px;border:1px dashed #283024;border-radius:2px;pointer-events:none;transition:border-color .12s}
854:.ps-empty b{display:block;font:700 7px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.12em;color:#8a9486}
855:.ps-empty small{display:block;margin-top:3px;font:600 6px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;color:#4d554b}
858:.loaded .ps-empty{display:none}
859:.ps-meta{grid-area:meta;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-width:0;margin:0;padding:8px 10px;border-left:1px solid #171d17}
862:.ps-actions{grid-area:act;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:8px 10px;border-left:1px solid #171d17}
863:.ps-btn{height:24px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:6px;padding:0 12px;border:1px solid #252b23;border-radius:4px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#151915,#0d100d);color:#7a8475;font:800 7.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.1em;white-space:nowrap;cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .12s,color .12s,background .12s,box-shadow .12s}
872:.ps-drop{position:absolute;inset:0;z-index:5;display:none;place-items:center;border:1px dashed var(--r3-accent);border-radius:inherit;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at center,rgba(200,255,0,.13),rgba(9,11,9,.94) 72%);font:700 7.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--r3-accent);text-shadow:0 0 10px rgba(200,255,0,.55);pointer-events:none}
874:.drop-live>.ps-drop{display:grid}
877:.pad-smp{position:absolute;right:20px;top:4px;display:none;padding:1px 3px;border:1px solid rgba(32,215,194,.45);border-radius:2px;background:rgba(32,215,194,.07);color:var(--r3-cyan);font:700 5.5px var(--r3-mono);letter-spacing:.08em;line-height:1.2}
878:.drum-pad.has-sample .pad-smp{display:block}

880:.drum-pad.has-sample .pad-sub{color:#5fb3a6;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
881:.drum-pad.drop-over{background:linear-gradient(180deg,#1b2410,#0b1009);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px var(--r3-accent),inset 0 0 26px rgba(200,255,0,.14)}
